physicalNotes: Radius 0.25765055 Jupiter radii from Wood et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165...85W), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165...85W/abstract): 18,420 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0273 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
